decision_question: Does the campaign own a resolved Known Good and Known Bad pair whose failures are bound to the mechanisms they demonstrate?
hypothesis: A Known Bad is only usable as a discrimination reference when every recorded history event is bound to the mechanism it demonstrates.
uncertainty: Synthetic test fixture / NOT_FOR_PHYSICAL_EXECUTION: the dossiers, history events, and mechanism references are fabricated for contract validation.

evidence.statement: Synthetic test fixture / NOT_FOR_PHYSICAL_EXECUTION: the Known Good dossier cites a service history record without a recorded failure.
Synthetic test fixture / NOT_FOR_PHYSICAL_EXECUTION: the Known Bad dossier cites a bench failure event bound to the oil-bleed mechanism it demonstrates.

decision_rule: A reference set whose Known Bad list holds at least one RESOLVED dossier must declare DISCRIMINATION_EVIDENCE_COMPLETE; a set with tier UNRESOLVED must declare DISCRIMINATION_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE.
result: The reference set holds one resolved Known Good and one resolved Known Bad, so the discrimination evidence is declared complete.
next_action: Use the resolved pair as the discrimination ruler for the bench campaign.
